description: This Java class 'PreferenceWorker' provides utility methods for managing user preferences, including permission checks, preference conversions, and access control within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PreferenceWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for user preference management, permission validation, and data conversion within OFBiz.

methods.name: addPrefToMap
methods.description: Adds a user preference record to a preference map, converting data types as needed.

methods.name: checkCopyPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to copy preferences, considering admin rights.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to get or set preferences based on the action.

methods.name: createUserPrefMap
methods.description: Converts a GenericValue or list of GenericValues into a user preference map.

methods.name: getUserLoginId
methods.description: Retrieves the user login ID from context, defaulting if not present.

methods.name: isValidGetId
methods.description: Validates if the current user can retrieve preferences for a given userLoginId.

methods.name: isValidSetId
methods.description: Validates if the current user can set preferences for a given userLoginId.

methods.name: toFieldMap
methods.description: Creates a map of fields for preference record creation or update, converting data types.
